text: Delete Risk Guard 是一个面向 DSH Host 的插件，在工具调用执行前检查可能涉及文件删除的操作。它监听工具执行前事件，分析命令参数和目标路径，并根据配置决定是否请求用户确认。配置可指定保护路径、确认阈值、临时路径和可重新生成目录的处理方式；还可设置扫描数量与时间上限，以及是否记录审计信息。适合希望在 DSH 工具运行期间查看删除操作并按路径策略确认的用户。源码未显示需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

Delete Risk Guard checks file deletion calls before DSH tools run. It analyzes arguments and paths, then requests approval based on configured rules. Scan limits and audit recording are configurable. No API key or external service is shown in the inspected source.
想在 DSH 执行删除文件的工具调用前先看到确认提示。
让 DSH 按不同目录配置是否需要确认文件删除。
I want DSH to inspect file-removal tool calls before execution and let me review them.
Delete Risk Guard 的功能「执行前检查删除调用」：插件在工具执行前分析命令和参数中的删除目标，再根据目标路径及配置决定是否要求用户确认。
Delete Risk Guard 的功能「设置检查范围」：用户可配置受保护路径、静默路径、确认阈值和扫描限制，以调整哪些删除调用会被提示或记录。

@pisceslailai/dsh-delete-risk-guard README · Delete Risk Guard：> 中文说明与发布备注：[NOTES.zh-CN.md](NOTES.zh-CN.md)

A Host-only DeepSeek Harness bundle. Every tool call that would delete files
under a protected directory is audited before it runs and surfaced to the user
as an approval prompt.

@pisceslailai/dsh-delete-risk-guard README · What it does：The guard listens on `tools/pre-execute`. It analyzes the call's arguments,
extracts deletion intents, resolves their targets against the protection roots,
scans each target for file count and size, and rates the deletion:

| Level | Example |
|---|---|
| `critical` | the root itself, a parent of the root, a recursive delete of `.dsh`/`.pi`, or a wildcard clear |
| `high` | a recursive delete of another directory, or a single protected file |
| `medium` | a single file elsewhere under the root |

@pisceslailai/dsh-delete-risk-guard README · The audit opinion：The approval card carries a decision, not just the command. Its single text
block is ordered the way a decision is made:

@pisceslailai/dsh-delete-risk-guard README · The audit opinion：| Section | Content |
|---|---|
| verdict | `⛔ 建议拒绝` / `⚠️ 谨慎：建议先备份再决定` / `✅ 影响有限，核对后可允许` / `❓ 无法判定，建议拒绝` |
| 对象 | what the target actually is: DSH 配置与会话根目录 / DSH 历史会话 / profile 配置 / .pi 配置 / 个人文档 / 构建产物/缓存 / 单个文件 … |
| 影响 | what would be lost, and whether it is recoverable; irreversible targets say 不进回收站，无法撤销 |
| 范围 | file count, size, truncation, wildcard, recursion, extra targets |
| 建议 | the safer alternative for this verdict (back up first, narrow the target, retry with an absolute path) |
| 核对 | the two questions worth answering before clicking Allow |
| 命令 | the command, clipped |

@pisceslailai/dsh-delete-risk-guard README · The audit opinion：Classification is path-based. Anything below `.dsh` names its section
(`sessions`, `profiles`, `storages`, `attachments`, `plugins`), so deleting
`.dsh/sessions` says "所有历史会话记录" instead of repeating the generic warning.

Covered command surfaces:

@pisceslailai/dsh-delete-risk-guard README · Behavior under an approval policy of `never`：The approval service short-circuits `ask` to `rejected` when the session policy
is `never`, so the guard checks the session's recorded policy first and returns
an explicit denial carrying the same audit instead of a silent block. Switch the
permission preset to one with `approval: ask` to get interactive prompts.

@pisceslailai/dsh-delete-risk-guard README · Tiers：A protection root carries its own prompt threshold, so coverage can be wide
without prompting for every routine cleanup:

```yaml
protectRoots:
  - path: '~'          # home: every deletion prompts
    askFromRisk: low
  - path: 'D:\'        # other drives/repos: only recursive deletes, wildcard

@pisceslailai/dsh-delete-risk-guard README · Tiers：A target is recorded without a prompt when it lies inside a `silentRoots` entry
or when its classification is regenerable (`node_modules`, `dist`, `build`,
`tmp`, …). The silent rule never applies to a *parent* of a silent root, so
deleting `AppData` still prompts even though `AppData\Local\Temp` does not.
`auditAllDeletes` writes every judged deletion — including out-of-scope and
silent ones — to the audit trail, so "covered but quiet" is still reviewable.

@pisceslailai/dsh-delete-risk-guard README · Tiers：The deployed profile sets `auditLog: false`. The log records deletions but
cannot restore anything, and a prompted decision already persists in the
session as its `approval/asked` + `approval/decided` pair, so the extra file
bought little.

@pisceslailai/dsh-delete-risk-guard README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `protectRoots` | `['~']` | `{ path, askFromRisk }` entries (a bare string uses `askFromRisk`) |
| `askFromRisk` | `low` | default threshold for roots that do not set one |
| `silentRoots` | `['%TEMP%']` | paths recorded without a prompt |
| `silentRebuildable` | `true` | record regenerable directories without a prompt |
| `auditAllDeletes` | `true` | log every judged deletion, not only the prompted ones |
| `protectedNames` | `['.dsh', '.pi']` | top-level names under a root rated `critical` when cleared |
| `sensitiveNames` | `AppData`, `Documents`, …, `.git` | names rated above an ordinary directory |
| `maxScanEntries` | `5000` | file-count cap per audit |
| `scanBudgetMs` | `800` | wall-clock cap per audit |
| `auditLog` | `true` | append a JSON line per judged deletion |
| `auditLogPath` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-delete-risk-guard\audit.jsonl` | audit trail location |
| `unknownTargetPolicy` | `auto` | `ask` for unresolvable targets that mention a protected location, `ignore`, or `always` |

@pisceslailai/dsh-delete-risk-guard README · Configuration：Unknown fields, wrong types, an invalid per-root threshold, and an empty
`protectRoots` throw at plugin load.

@pisceslailai/dsh-delete-risk-guard README · Known limits：- It is a command-argument guard, not a filesystem filter: deletions performed
  inside a script file, an opaque tool, or a program that rewrites paths at
  runtime cannot be inspected, and an unresolvable target is only asked about
  when the command mentions a protected location (`unknownTargetPolicy: always`
  makes every unresolved deletion ask).
- Content truncation (`Clear-Content`, `Set-Content ""`, overwriting a file with
  `write`) is not a deletion and is not audited.
- The audit log appends without rotation.

@pisceslailai/dsh-delete-risk-guard README · Files：```
index.js           plugin entry (name/inject/apply)
lib/analyze.js     deletion-intent and target extraction
lib/assess.js      risk rating and scanning
lib/decide.js      tiered decision: prompt / record / ignore
